free_tier.stated: Free at USD 0 forever with a 300-credit monthly limit and a credit hard limit; credits are spent by deploys, compute, bandwidth and requests from one pool.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pricing page; the pool is total credits, not a per-object size

retention.stated: not stated on the pricing page read

egress.terms: bandwidth costs 20 credits per GB from the 300-credit pool

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: 300 credits a month is 30 GB-hours, which is 30 hours of a 1 GiB function, or about an hour a day across a month; Netlify Database and Blob storage draw from the same pool, so a storage backend must live elsewhere.

limits.value: 300 credits a month, one pool for deploys, compute, bandwidth and requests
compute 10 credits per GB-hour, bandwidth 20 credits per GB, requests 2 credits per 10k, production deploys 15 credits each

15 minutes per build by default, plus up to 5 more minutes for post-processing; a build that runs past the limit is stopped. A longer limit is not self-service in the web UI: the API accepts build_timelimit up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes) and Netlify Support sets longer ones (3600 seconds, one hour). Support replies disagree on who qualifies: a card on file, the Pro tier, or a Starter team raised to 30 minutes with no stated condition; for a credit-plan Free team it is unverified
1 concurrent build on Free, counted across the whole team
no monthly build-minute allowance on the credit plans: build minutes are not metered, each production deploy costs 15 credits, and deploy previews and branch deploys cost 0 credits

limits_note: one 300-credit monthly pool is shared by deploys, compute, bandwidth and requests, and the free plan has a hard limit with no recharge, so a site that serves 15 GB of bandwidth in a month has spent its whole allowance and then pauses.
binding_note: 300 credits is 30 GB-hours of compute or 15 GB of bandwidth, and both come out of the same 300.

identity_cost.detail: a Netlify account; no card on the Free plan, and the plan has a hard credit limit rather than an overage

evidence.proved: Free plan: 300 credit limit; rates 15 credits per production deploy, 10 credits per GB-hour compute, 20 credits per GB bandwidth, 2 credits per 10k requests, quoted
